newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Buba's Issing warns no "window dressing" for EMU.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Issing warns no "window dressing" for EMU.

text.p: Bundesbank chief economist Otmar Issing warned on Thursday against any effort by EU member states to "window dress" their economic position in order to be able to join Europe's planned currency union.
"As Hans Tietmeyer has said already, we view with some concern attempts to alter budgetary positions (ahead of EMU)," Issing told journalists on the sidelines of a conference on monetary union.
"That must not happen," Issing said referring to last-ditch efforts to make the grade to be among the first nations to join EMU in 1999.
Issing declined to make specific comments on any individual nations' chances on being part of the first group on countries to launch the single currency.
He will later make a speech at the conference.
